definitions: To break or chip off in flakes.
To fail to keep an appointment or promise; to abandon a commitment.
To behave in an unreliable or inconsistent way.
examples: The paint started to flake off the old wall.
The pastry will flake if you handle it too much.
He tends to flake on his plans at the last minute.
Don't flake out on me now, we have work to do.
